import pandas as pd,numpy as np,cv2
df=pd.read_csv('out_test/demo_metadata.csv'); orig=pd.read_csv('demo_metadata.csv')
im=cv2.imread('demo_rgb.png'); h,w=im.shape[:2]
cnt=np.zeros((h,w),int); vis=im.copy(); vo=im.copy()
try:
    from shapely.geometry import Polygon; sh=True
except: sh=False
bad=0
for (_,r),(_,o) in zip(df.iterrows(),orig.iterrows()):
    xs=list(map(int,r.coords_x.split(','))); ys=list(map(int,r.coords_y.split(',')))
    p=np.array(list(zip(xs,ys)),np.int32)
    m=np.zeros((h,w),np.uint8); cv2.fillPoly(m,[p],1); cnt+=m
    n,_=cv2.connectedComponents(m)
    if n!=2: bad+=1
    if sh and not Polygon(p).is_valid: print('invalid',r.iloc[0])
    assert r.xmin==min(xs) and r.xmax==max(xs)
    cv2.polylines(vis,[p],True,(0,255,0),1)
    po=np.array(list(zip(map(int,o.coords_x.split(',')),map(int,o.coords_y.split(',')))),np.int32)
    cv2.polylines(vo,[po],True,(0,0,255) if o.type=='rectangle' else (255,0,0),1)
print('overlap px',(cnt>1).sum(),'multi-cc',bad,'shapely',sh, list(df.columns)==list(orig.columns), (df.iloc[:,:5].drop(columns='type')==orig.iloc[:,:5].drop(columns='type')).all().all())
big=np.concatenate([cv2.resize(vo,None,fx=2,fy=2,interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST),cv2.resize(vis,None,fx=2,fy=2,interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST)],1)
cv2.imwrite('/tmp/obench-cell-l_6kly_m/bench_opencode_sam-cell-seg_21pms5hi/out_test/vis.png',big)
